arms: relational: learned q-specific cross-context causal operator
global_relation: pooled learned operator ignoring q
shuffled_relation: history q labels deterministically shuffled (929209001)
CART: depth-5, leaf>=10, trained historical observations with observed base-bit posterior features; local Bayes update
RF16: 16 trees depth-7, leaf>=5, same history and local Bayes update
logistic: fit logistic regression using all historical outcomes and identical per-world features; local Bayes update

classification_rules.invalid: Source/prereg identity mismatch; incomplete seed/case, leaked heldout labels, changed noise/tasks/thresholds, or execution/audit error; do not reclassify statistical failure.
classification_rules.mixed: Partial improvements without full GO: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO with exploratory positives labeled.
classification_rules.negative: Any frozen GO check false with valid execution: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, preserve nulls and no tuning to rescue primary.
classification_rules.supported: All seven frozen boolean checks in runner true. External DEVELOPMENT_GO only. Formal SCIENTIFIC_PASS needs separate qualified disjoint native Yggdrasil study and strongest matched controls.

frozen_go_checks: relational false unseen <= independent false unseen
relational overall validation accuracy >= strongest CART/RF16/logistic +0.005

frozen_mechanisms.data_generator: Context 0 uses 2-cause Boolean truth table. Context 1 = context0 XOR fixed per-mode pattern. Generator patterns q0=[0,1,1,0], q1=[1,0,0,0], q2=[1,1,0,1]. q2 is NOT in training.
frozen_mechanisms.data_order: 128 training histories generated under seed 929200401 first; each history contains 12 observations per action per context; new cohort each seed shuffles 80 q assignments. Per test world shuffle 112 c0, 16 c1 fit actions, and independent 256 validation actions balanced across 8 context-actions.
frozen_mechanisms.hypothesis_space: 256 possible 8-bit contextual truth tables, two contexts x four interventions

hypothesis: Learning per-cause outcome-change probabilities across historical interventions yields at least 10 more exact accepted familiar-context mechanisms than independent inference, at least 5 more than pooled/shuffled relation controls, and at least 0.5 percentage-point higher total heldout accuracy than the best trained conventional control without excessive false acceptances.

inputs.label_inspection: No evaluation labels or metrics inspected before prospective freeze
inputs.name: Independent procedural causal worlds generated from frozen source
inputs.sha256: GENERATED_AFTER_PREREG; records and exact source+seed hashes saved in primary result
inputs.source: No external human data or model training data; two contexts, two causes, q-family indicated. Training base families 0..7; unseen evaluation base families 8..15. Full original outcomes generated after prereg.

learner.acceptance: Posterior max >=0.9 and fitting-data binomial misfit survival p >0.01; validation observations NEVER used for acceptance.
learner.cold_retention: Serialize learned context flip distribution to JSON and deserialize; exact array equality required.
learner.inference: 256-state exact Bayesian posterior on all 128 per-world fit observations; joint prior couples 2 contexts per cause. Unknown q=2 uses independent prior.
learner.training_method: Each past history independently infers 2x4 latent causal outcome bits under frozen 35% noise likelihood; a context-conditioned per-action flip probability is estimated by pooling the posterior cross-context differences across histories, with Beta(1,1) smoothing.

metrics: Exact accepted contextual truth tables on 192 familiar-mode worlds and 48 unseen-mode worlds
False accepted contextual truth tables separately on familiar/unseen
Total heldout outcome prediction accuracy, 240 x 256 validation actions
End-to-end local wall seconds, meta-learning training seconds and archived observations
Paired-by-world accuracy and exactness vs controls
